description: 对话练习：Story time + Cartoon time 完整内容，角色扮演跟读

sections.title: Story time — What a wonderful journey!

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: Hello! I'm a cardboard box.
lines.chinese: 你好！我是一个硬纸板箱。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: I got here in the morning.
lines.chinese: 我早上到这里的。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: What will they do with me?
lines.chinese: 他们会怎么处理我呢？

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: Will they throw me away? Oh no!
lines.chinese: 他们会把我扔掉吗？哦，不要啊！

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: In the afternoon, a man picked the box up and put it into a recycling bin.
lines.chinese: 下午，一个男人把箱子捡起来，放进了回收箱。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: Then I got on a truck.
lines.chinese: 然后我上了一辆卡车。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: There were plastic cups, plastic bottles and glass bottles on the truck too.
lines.chinese: 卡车上也有塑料杯、塑料瓶和玻璃瓶。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: We said hello to each other.
lines.chinese: 我们互相打招呼。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: The truck took us to a recycling centre.
lines.chinese: 卡车把我们带到了一个回收中心。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: Workers put us into different groups.
lines.chinese: 工人们把我们分成不同的组。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: I went into a big machine.
lines.chinese: 我进入了一台大机器。

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: There I went to sleep. What a long sleep!
lines.chinese: 在那里我睡着了。好长的一觉啊！

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: Hello again! It's me!
lines.chinese: 又见面了！是我！

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: Now I'm in a library. Yes, I'm a book now!
lines.chinese: 现在我在一个图书馆里。是的，我现在是一本书了！

lines.speaker: Cardboard Box
lines.english: Children like me very much. How wonderful!
lines.chinese: 孩子们非常喜欢我。多么奇妙啊！

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: It is Thursday. The students are doing an art project with old things.
lines.chinese: 今天是星期四。学生们正在用旧物品做一个美术项目。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: What did you make with your old things, Billy?
lines.chinese: Billy，你用旧物品做了什么？

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: I made this bag with old trousers.
lines.chinese: 我用旧裤子做了这个袋子。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: How nice!
lines.chinese: 真好看啊！

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Look at this toy fish. I made it with a plastic bag and some paper.
lines.chinese: 看这条玩具鱼。我用一个塑料袋和一些纸做的。

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: What a big fish!
lines.chinese: 好大的一条鱼啊！

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: I made this picture with old buttons.
lines.chinese: 我用旧纽扣做了这幅画。

lines.speaker: All
lines.english: What a beautiful picture!
lines.chinese: 好漂亮的一幅画啊！

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: Your turn, Bobby.
lines.chinese: 轮到你了，Bobby。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I made this hat with a cardboard box.
lines.chinese: 我用一个硬纸板箱做了这顶帽子。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: But it was rainy this morning. The hat got wet and broke.
lines.chinese: 但是今天早上下雨了。帽子湿了，然后坏了。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Oh! What a pity!
lines.chinese: 哦！真可惜！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Don't worry. I can make a new one.
lines.chinese: 别担心。我可以做一顶新的。

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: Great! You're so clever!
lines.chinese: 太棒了！你真聪明！
